name: Game Room

features.name: Tavla
features.description: Classic Tavla matches against AI1, AI2, or the connected US1 remote user.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomBackgammonStart
commandSpecs.description: Start a new Tavla match from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomBackgammonReset
commandSpecs.description: Reset the active Tavla match state.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomBackgammonUserMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the user's Tavla legal move from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomBackgammonAiMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the AI Tavla move returned by the selected opponent slot.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomBackgammonRemoteMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the remote US1 Tavla move delivered over room mail transport.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomBackgammonAcceptInvite
commandSpecs.description: Accept an incoming US1 Tavla invite from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomBackgammonRejectInvite
commandSpecs.description: Reject an incoming US1 Tavla invite from the room UI.

features.name: Team Tetris
features.description: A four-seat, turn-based team Tetris mode for the local user, AI1, AI2, and the connected US1 remote user.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisStart
commandSpecs.description: Start a new Team Tetris match from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisReset
commandSpecs.description: Reset the active Team Tetris match state.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisUserMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the local user's Team Tetris path selection from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisAiMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the Team Tetris move returned by AI1 or AI2.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisRemoteMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the Team Tetris move delivered over the connected US1 transport.

features.name: Yahtzee
features.description: A candlelit pirate-deck Yahtzee table for solo play, two local players, AI1, AI2, or the connected US1 remote user.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeStart
commandSpecs.description: Start a solo or two-player Yahtzee match from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeReset
commandSpecs.description: Reset the active Yahtzee game or match.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeRoll
commandSpecs.description: Roll all non-held Yahtzee dice for the locally controlled seat using host-owned randomness.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeToggleHold
commandSpecs.description: Toggle one die between held and rerollable state for the locally controlled seat.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeScore
commandSpecs.description: Commit the current dice to one unused Yahtzee score category for the locally controlled seat.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeAiAction
commandSpecs.description: Apply a host-validated Yahtzee legalActionId returned by AI1 or AI2.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeRemoteStart
commandSpecs.description: Create the mirrored side of an incoming US1 Yahtzee match.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeRemoteSync
commandSpecs.description: Apply a newer synchronized US1 Yahtzee match revision.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomYahtzeeRemoteReset
commandSpecs.description: Reset the mirrored US1 Yahtzee match.

features.name: Fate Knots
features.description: A deterministic collaborative story game built from validated, persistent forged universes and resumable runs.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsGetHubState
commandSpecs.description: Read the player-safe neutral Fate Knots Hub state.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsActivateUniverse
commandSpecs.description: Select one already accepted Fate Knots universe in the neutral Hub.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsGetRunSetup
commandSpecs.description: Read player-safe selectable character setup data for one accepted universe.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsCreateRun
commandSpecs.description: Create a canonical run from an accepted universe and player-character assignments.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsStartRun
commandSpecs.description: Open a prepared Fate Knots run at its Forge-authored start node.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsGetGameplayState
commandSpecs.description: Read one player-safe Fate Knots active-run projection without exposing hidden canon.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsGetCombatOptions
commandSpecs.description: Read the local player's current legal Fate Knots combat card and target options.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsGetCombatDiscussion
commandSpecs.description: Read the shared party-only Fate Knots combat discussion.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsSendCombatMessage
commandSpecs.description: Post the local player's message to shared Fate Knots combat discussion.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsAi2CombatMessage
commandSpecs.description: Post AI2's player message to shared Fate Knots combat discussion.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsRemoteCombatMessage
commandSpecs.description: Post US1's remote player message to shared Fate Knots combat discussion.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsCompleteCombatMove
commandSpecs.description: Lock the local player's legal Fate Knots combat move.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsAi2CompleteCombatMove
commandSpecs.description: Lock AI2's legal Fate Knots combat move.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsRemoteCompleteCombatMove
commandSpecs.description: Lock US1's legal Fate Knots combat move.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsActivateRun
commandSpecs.description: Select one persisted Fate Knots run for continuation.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsDeleteRun
commandSpecs.description: Delete one persisted Fate Knots run without rewriting its universe.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsDeleteUniverse
commandSpecs.description: Delete an accepted Fate Knots universe and its associated runs.

description: A focused Game Room for Tavla, four-seat Team Tetris, pirate-deck Yahtzee, and the Fate Knots collaborative story game.
